name: W. F. Houk
role: Cow Boy compositor from Belfield; later at the Glendive Independent
bio: W. F. (Will) Houk of Belfield turned twenty-three in March 1884, signed the call for that April's Billings County Republican convention and served on the delegate committee at the August convention, and helped get out the Cow Boy in July 1884 while the editor was away. In October 1884 he left for Glendive to take a position on the Independent, and the paper later remembered him as "Sadie" Houk, a Cow Boy compositor.
